title: Infrastructure weekly update — 2026-07-06
body:
Summary:
- Focus this week: stabilize GPU autoscaler, finish us-west-2 capacity bump, and validate new quantized runtime on A100s.
- Still carrying follow-ups on cost modeling for spot vs reserved placement.

Highlights:
- Autoscaler beta rollout started for serving-runtime (canary traffic in us-east-1 and eu-west-1). Initial results: scale-up latency ~45s median for cold-starts, downscale safe window tuned to 5m.
- us-west-2 capacity add completed: +40 A100 (v4) provisioned and tested. Verified scheduling in k8s pool infra-gpu-west-2-prod.
- Incident INFRA-1239 (OOMs after kernel module update) resolved by rolling back the driver on affected nodes. Full postmortem draft linked above.

Fleet health / metrics (as of 2026-07-06 08:00 UTC):
- Total GPUs: 760 (us-west-2: 320, us-east-1: 240, eu-west-1: 200)
- Avg GPU utilization (last 7d): 62% overall, 68% serving, 42% batch jobs
- Pending capacity requests: 1 (customer A — high-priority, need 60 A10G-equivalent units for next 2 weeks)
- Preemptible/spot usage: 23% of running capacity (target 25% for non-latency workloads)

Regions / capacity planning:
- us-west-2: Completed immediate request. Next step: increase reserved pool by +60 A10 (proposal in Confluence).
- us-east-1: Autoscaler canary shows 15% lower-than-expected downscale frequency (sticky pods). Working on pod disruption budgets and safe eviction heuristics.
- eu-west-1: Running low on headroom for peak batch windows. We should either move some batch traffic to us-east-1 or schedule a small spot capacity buy.

Cost / economics:
- Preliminary estimates for the us-west-2 A100 add: incremental run-rate ~$57k/month (after committed discount).
- Spot sensitivity: observed 18% price volatility last 30d in us-east-1. Recommending conservative target: cap spot to 30% of non-latency pool.

Serving/runtime notes:
- New quantized runtime validated on A100s: 1.9x throughput improvement for 8-bit model path in microbenchmarks. Integration test failures seen in long-context chat (KV cache invalidation) — tracking in PR #486.
- Routing policy update deployed to canary: fallback to smaller model variant when latency > 600ms for >3 consecutive requests. No customer impact seen in canary so far.

Incidents / outages:
- INFRA-1239: Kernel driver regression caused intermittent OOMs on ~12 nodes (us-east-1). Rollback performed Tue 2026-07-01 02:10 UTC. Postmortem draft points to incomplete driver compatibility tests in our node image pipeline. Action: add compatibility matrix tests to release pipeline (owner: Marco).

Open blockers and risks:
- Capacity procurement lead time: vendor quoting delays for next-gen A10G. If quotes not finalized by 2026-07-12, we may miss customer A SLA.
- Autoscaler edge-case: stateful pods with large KV caches not respecting safe eviction; risk of increased cold-start latency.

Action items (owners):
- Marco: finalize compatibility tests and update node image pipeline (due 2026-07-09). Linked JIRA-INFRA-1252.
- Lena: run a simulated failover test for eu-west-1 peak window next Wed (2026-07-08).
- Rahul: complete cost model for spot/reserved mixes and present options in next capacity review (2026-07-10).
- Aisha: schedule stakeholder meeting with customer A to confirm timelines and fallback plans (by 2026-07-07).

Standup notes (this week's recurring):
- Mon: sync with SRE on blackbox monitoring thresholds (tuned GPU mem pressure alert to 90%).
- Wed: autoscaler observability walkthrough (added histogram for scale-up time).
- Fri: capacity planning deep-dive (presented three procurement scenarios).

Meeting outcomes / decisions:
- Agreed to keep spot cap at 30% until next cost review.
- Approve procurement scenario B (incremental reserved + moderate spot) for us-west-2; finance will issue Purchase Order after quote confirmation.

Misc / notes to self:
- Keep close on PR #486 (infra runtime fixes) — fixes KV cache invalidation in long context.
- Remind platform team to version node images in release notes.
- Follow up with sales on customer A timeline — potential to trade capacity for extended commit.

Drafts / links referenced:
- GPU Fleet Capacity Plan (Confluence) — linked above.
- Postmortem INFRA-1239 (draft).
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/486

Next week's focus:
- Finish autoscaler rollout to us-east-1 (remove canary flags if stable), finish cost model, and finalize procurement for additional A10 capacity.

Quick TODOs:
- [ ] Marco: add compatibility matrix tests (JIRA-INFRA-1252).
- [ ] Lena: schedule and run eu-west-1 failover test.
- [ ] Rahul: cost model deliverable.
- [ ] Aisha: customer A stakeholder meeting.

End of update.
